items.title: SteamLite 26.11.5
items.text: A mainline feature update that adds this roadmap to News, so you can see what we are working on and how far along it is.
features: A Roadmap tab in News, kept up to date from GitHub without needing a release

items.title: SteamLite 26.12 Beta
items.text: The Animation Initiative (AI): we fix animations and optimise the current ones so they run better while your PC is running games.
features: Fixes for animations that stutter or misbehave
Animations pause or simplify while a game is running
Lighter animations that use less of your GPU

items.title: SteamLite 26.12
items.text: The Animation Initiative moves from the beta to the stable release, and is carried on the beta channel too.

items.title: SteamLite 27.1 Beta, with Graphine
items.text: Graphine is our new engine, made only for SteamLite. We will not ship it until we know it is stable and tested on other PCs.
items.note: This beta only releases on the 15th if Graphine is stable enough. If it is not ready, this date will move and we will say so here.
